d:
Experience the timeless romance of Surili Akhiyon Wale from Veer in stunning 8K/4K resolution!
Featuring the soulful voices of Rahat Fateh Ali Khan and Suzanne D'Mello, this beautiful love ballad captures the magic of Salman Khan and Zarine Khan’s on-screen romance. With music composed by Sajid-Wajid and lyrics by Gulzar, relive this heartfelt melody in enhanced visual quality.
Credits
Song Name: Surili Akhiyon Wale
Movie: Veer
Singers: Rahat Fateh Ali Khan, Suzanne D'Mello
Composer: Sajid-Wajid
Lyricist: Gulzar
